# dsh-effort-router
English | 中文
**Version:** `0.2.16-rc.2` (DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 compatible) · Changelog · Roadmap
A DSH (DeepSeek Harness) plugin: **context-aware per-step reasoning-effort routing**, plus reasoning
levels for hand-declared `llm-pi-ai` custom models.
- **The drift engine** (0.2.8; integer ranks since 0.2.16): the task ORIGIN CLASS is classified once
from the brief the user sent (`trivial / standard / engineering / hard`); `routes` maps it to an in
teger origin rank, then evidence drifts the **rank** — `targetRank = originRank + error channel + vo

lume channel − frugal`, clamped to the hard-anchor ceiling
- Error channel (short 6-step window, dec
ay-weighted): tool errors, identical-argument retries, event bumps (a just-completed todo, an orches
tration return, a compaction checkpoint — each +1 once per step), and a carry from the previous task

's unresolved failure
- Volume channel (long 32-step window): brief and tool-result tokens, **gzip-r

atio discounted** (repetition is not information), graded by two linear ramps
- Warm-up floor: a fre
sh task never routes below its origin for the first steps (default 3); afterwards drift owns the lev

el — aggressive saving, with the short error window as the feedback loop
- Wish detector: a short de
legation-style brief in the cue vacuum zone (`帮我…`, `can you…`) starts at the engineering floor — un

derspecified tasks get the benefit of the doubt
- Frugal signals: subagents, context pressure, or a

session token budget demote one rank
- Capability mapping: the target rank maps onto the model's adv
ertised selector ids; the optional global `allowedEfforts` list constrains the final id, and `effort

Fallback` chooses `nearest-up` (compat), `up`, or `down` with boundary clamping
[该节后续省略]
## Why an Auto mask instead of a panel
The host's native model selector already is the per-session effort control. The plugin advertises an
`Auto` level on every reasoning-capable model (injected into `reasoning.efforts`, resolved to a con
crete wire level by the request interceptor before validation), so there is **no second selector to
keep in sync**: Auto schedules, a concrete level passes through.
## Custom models (llm-pi-ai)
**Since DSH 0.2.1 the Models page can declare reasoning levels per custom model in the UI** (a switc
h plus one row per level), so editing the config file is no longer required. The plugin's auto-fill
therefore narrows to **models declared in the profile layer that the settings user layer has never t
ouched**: once a model appears in the user layer (edited in the UI) it is treated as user-owned — th
e UI's switch stores OFF by REMOVING the field, so re-filling it would silently undo that choice, an
d the fill skips it. Catalog models that already inherit levels resolve WITH levels and are skipped,
so catalog capability is never shadowed; an explicit table or an explicit `false` is never touched.
The filled table is `{ low, high, max }`, deliberately with **no `off` rung**: an off selection fol
lowed by a tool call poisons the conversation for every later thinking-enabled request, and the rout
er never routes to off either. Models filled on explicit `openai-completions` routes also gain `comp
at.supportsReasoningEffort: true`, the switch that protocol needs to actually send the effort. Set `
fillCustomModels: false` to let the Models page own every declaration. A profile-declared model that
tomModels: false` to let the Models page own every declaration. A profile-declared model that [长行截断]
The per-model level → gateway wire-value mapping (e.g. `high → ultra`) lives in the model's `reasoni
ngEfforts` table inside the `llm-pi-ai` config — edit it directly or ask your agent to. The official
schema validates it and the next request picks it up. pi-ai serializes the table natively; no plugi
n-side translation layer.
## Configuration (no settings UI — everything lives in the config file)
**The plugin deliberately ships NO settings UI** (since 0.2.7-rc.6): every user-facing option lives
in the plugin configuration, stored on the profile side, so **upgrading the plugin package never ove
rwrites it**. Change options by editing the config or by asking your agent in natural language ("hid
e the badge", "allow max").

- `enabled`: master switch (off = requests pass through untouched)
- `defaultLevel`: level when noth

ing is selected (`auto` or a concrete level)
- `subagentEffort`: subagent default (`inherit` or a co

ncrete level)
- `allowedEfforts`: optional global final selector-id allow-list (`minimal/low/medium/
high/xhigh/max/ultra`); empty = every advertised non-off level. `off/none/auto` are reserved and rej

ected
- `effortFallback`: missing-target behaviour — `nearest-up` (compatibility default), `up`, or

`down`; directional modes clamp at the available boundary
- `allowMax` / `maxFallback`: **deprecated
in 0.2.16**. `allowMax=false` migrates to an `allowedEfforts` ceiling up to `maxFallback`; setting

both old and new controls is reported as a conflict
- `wish` / `poisonRecovery` / `frugalDemote` / `
contextPressure` / `sessionTokenBudget`: wish detector, poison recovery, frugal demotion and their t

hresholds
- `showBadge`: show the read-only badge left of the composer model selector (default on)
-
`trajectoryAnnotate`: project each step's `provider/model · effort` onto the native trajectory ledg

er (default on; switch off if it conflicts with another plugin)
- `chatAnnotate`: add a `provider/mo
del · effort` caption row under each tool call in the conversation view (**default off**; read once

at client load, so a toggle applies on page reload)
- `fillCustomModels`: auto-fill default effort t

ables for hand-declared custom models
- `routes`: origin class → anchor rank (`minimal/low/medium/hi
gh/xhigh/max/ultra`; defaults trivial/standard low, engineering high, hard max). The four anchors mu

st be non-decreasing; an invalid table falls back as a whole with a warning
[该节后续省略]
## In-session visibility
[该节后续省略]
## Safety and degradation
- The interceptor is one try/catch: any error passes a concrete request through untouched; the plugi

n's virtual `Auto` sentinel is stripped even on that path (fail-open without leaking Auto)
[该节后续省略]
